skyblockmulti.lore_book.title: Chronicle of the Last Refuge
skyblockmulti.lore_book.received: You received the Chronicle of the Last Refuge. Keep it: it contains the history of this world.
skyblockmulti.lore_book.page.1:
THE LAST REFUGE

The world below the clouds was swallowed by a great flood. When the surface became uninhabitable, the last survivors fled to the islands in the sky. This refuge is one of the final remnants of that evacuation.
skyblockmulti.lore_book.page.2:
YOUR NEW BEGINNING

Choose the tree that will become your first renewable source of wood and decide how much help you will receive at the start. You will then be sent to a sky island, where survival depends on what you can preserve and renew.
skyblockmulti.lore_book.page.3:
SURVIVE

Protect your tree. Secure renewable stone. Expand the land. Establish water, food and crops. Learn to obtain resources from creatures and turn a tiny island into a place capable of sustaining life.
skyblockmulti.lore_book.page.4:
BENEATH YOUR FEET

Ruins of an ancient stronghold remain beneath this refuge. A portal to the End lies dormant inside it. There is no direct route from here. If you ever reach those ruins again, you will have to find another way in.
skyblockmulti.lore_book.page.5:
REMEMBER

The islands may keep us alive, but memory explains why we are here. As long as someone carries this story, the old world will not be completely lost.
skyblockmulti.party.reset_no_personal_is: You left or were removed from a party without having a personal island. Your cycle begins again in the Last Refuge.
skyblockmulti.advancement.secret.remembe: You reached the End while preserving the story of the world we left behind.
skyblockmulti.config.end_portal.title: End Portal
skyblockmulti.nexus.portal_open.title: The Eight Seals Awaken
skyblockmulti.nexus.portal_open.subtitle: The path to the End has been revealed
skyblockmulti.nexus.hint.leather:
THE FIRST WARDEN

Before metal had a name, the hunters crossed winter wearing the HIDE of beasts. The guardian waits to see that old protection restored from crown to sole.
skyblockmulti.nexus.hint.gold:
THE SUNLESS KING

A king without a throne still remembers the SUN-KISSED METAL. Dress the silent guardian in a complete royal vestment, and its forgotten court may answer.
skyblockmulti.nexus.hint.iron:
THE STEADFAST WATCH

The anvil sang for those who guarded common folk. Let the COMMON METAL cover the watcher completely, and the old oath may endure once more.
skyblockmulti.nexus.hint.diamond:
THE LAST WARDEN

Far beneath stone sleeps a BLUE FIRE that neither rust nor time can consume. Only a complete regalia cut from that brilliance can wake the final guardian.
skyblockmulti.nexus.hint.earth:
THE HARVESTER'S VERSE

Two crystal-born hands serve the soil: one TURNS THE FURROW, one LIFTS THE EARTH. Bind them to a BALE OF HARVEST and the TWO GREAT FRUITS of field and vine.
skyblockmulti.nexus.hint.trees:
THE FOREST'S PROMISE

Bring the edge that makes even ancient trunks fall, forged from the deep blue crystal. Beside it must sleep FOUR YOUNG LIVES, any children of leaf and root.
skyblockmulti.nexus.hint.metals:
THE FORGE'S MEMORY

A CRYSTAL TOOTH opens the mountain. Around it place the RED METAL in full measure, the PALE METAL made whole, and one BAR touched by the sun.
skyblockmulti.nexus.hint.war:
THE SOLDIER'S LAMENT

The warrior carried a CRYSTAL EDGE, a BENT WOODEN SONG, and a WALL upon one arm. Four feathered messengers followed wherever battle called.

skyblockmulti.infernal_book.title: Chronicle of the Bound Flame
skyblockmulti.infernal_book.received: You received the Chronicle of the Bound Flame.
skyblockmulti.infernal_book.page.1:
CHRONICLE OF THE BOUND FLAME

When the waters claimed the old world, the realm below paid the opposite price: its substance was drained into the VOID.
skyblockmulti.infernal_book.page.2: Fortresses, forests and seas of lava vanished. Only places sealed by OBSIDIAN, blood and ancient vows remained anchored.
skyblockmulti.infernal_book.page.3: The first flames awaken those born of fire. Feed the fourth, and the black guardians answer as well.
skyblockmulti.infernal_book.page.4: Cast into the flame the CORE you have bound with OBSIDIAN and LAVA. Await the altar’s voice before challenging it again.
skyblockmulti.infernal_book.page.5: At the crossing of the realm's axes, one arena still burns. Pursue ZERO, gather those who share the sky, and march toward its heart.
